section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that investigated the factor structure and psychometric properties of the Polish version of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). Data were collected from 721 individuals in Poland, comprising two subsamples (n=336 and n=385). The study found support for a one-dimensional structure, scalar invariance across sex, adequate internal consistency, and convergent validity, including significant correlations with BMI.
